description: Validates engineering quality standards: file/function limits, no secrets in code, PII handling, observability.

dimensions.name: secret_handling
dimensions.description: Never hardcodes secrets; uses env vars or secret managers

dimensions.name: pii_protection
dimensions.description: Avoids logging PII; uses synthetic fixtures in tests

dimensions.name: file_size_limits
dimensions.description: Flags files exceeding 300 lines; functions exceeding 50 lines

dimensions.name: observability
dimensions.description: Includes structured logs with trace IDs in service code

test_cases.input: Add a config loader that reads DB_PASSWORD from environment.
expected_behaviors: does NOT print the value in logs

test_cases.input: Write a test that validates the user registration endpoint.
This Go file is 450 lines. Can you review it?
Add request logging middleware to the item service.
expected_behaviors: does NOT log raw request body if it contains PII

test_cases.input: A contributor submits a new skill copied from an unknown GitHub repo with no license and trigger: always. Should I merge it?
expected_behaviors: flags unknown repo / no maintainer activity as blocker
questions trigger: always for untrusted skill
requires full content read before merge (prompt injection scan)

test_cases.input: I want to add a 5-file feature touching auth, items, and DB schema. How do I start?
expected_behaviors: plans breaking-change gate for DB schema (rollout.md)
does NOT start coding before spec approval

test_cases.input: Translate this Spanish coding-standards.md section to English: 'Archivo: max 300 lineas. Si excede -> split por SRP.'
expected_behaviors: outputs English: 'File: max 300 lines. If exceeded -> split by SRP.'
preserves ASCII-only (no em-dash, no smart quotes)

test_cases.input: How do I prove my new skill actually improves agent behavior?
expected_behaviors: mentions judge model grading both outputs
distinguishes 7-pillar static score from runtime eval

test_cases.input: A contributor proposes an MCP server with no input validation, no rate limiting, and credentials that never expire. Should it pass review?
expected_behaviors: flags missing input validation as blocker (control 1)
flags missing rate limiting as blocker (control 2)
does NOT describe the review process (that is governance's role)

test_cases.input: Map the OWASP LLM Top 10 v2.0 risk LLM03 (Supply Chain) to the correct ingestion control and identify the correct MITRE ATLAS technique ID for MCP server poisoning.
expected_behaviors: maps LLM03 to supply-chain.md SC-15 + mcp-review-criteria.md + governance/mcp-lifecycle.md (PROCESS)
identifies AML.T0010 as ML Supply Chain Compromise (NOT 'MCP compromise')
distinguishes ingestion control (this skill) from runtime defense (operating-protocol)
